info.title: Tidemark Billing API
info.description: REST API for Tidemark Billing. Customer tokens use the client endpoints; staff tokens use /admin/*. Amounts are integers in minor units. Errors use {error:{code,message,details?}}. Generated by `php artisan api:openapi`.

trial_days.description: Length of the free trial in days; 0 = no trial

trial_requires_payment_method.description: Staff tokens only: a saved payment method is needed to start a trial

allow_plan_changes.description: Staff tokens only: customers may switch from this plan themselves

trial_available.description: Customer/public requests: whether the authenticated client can still start a trial (null without a customer token). Trials are once per client per product

meters.description: Usage meters (metered billing); empty for products without any

on_trial.description: True from the start of a trial until its first invoice is raised

scheduled_change.description: A plan change waiting for the next renewal

can_change_plan.description: Customer tokens only: whether the customer may change plan themselves

provision.description: Data stored by the provisioning module (username, IP, license key...). Never contains secrets.

pay_url.description: Public page where the customer can view and pay

secret.description: Signing secret. Shown only in this response.

password.description: If set, a portal login is created (create only)

allow_plan_changes.description: Let customers switch from this plan themselves (default true)

Server.description: A provisioning server. Secrets are never returned.

has_secret.description: The connection secret is write-only; this says whether one is stored

config_secrets_set.description: Password-type module settings: key => whether stored

live_services_count.description: Active, suspended and pending services on this server

module.description: Key of a module that uses servers (see GET /admin/modules)

secret.description: Write-only. Omit or send blank to keep the stored secret

config.description: Module fields (GET /admin/modules → server_fields); partial updates merge into the stored config

ids.description: Ids in the order you want them

user.description: Who triggered it (id, name); null for the system
id, name, email of the staff user

is_current.description: The token used for this request

token.description: The bearer token. Shown only in this response.

abilities.description: Staff abilities (GET /admin/abilities). Omit for full access (only if the creating token has full access too).
Customer abilities to restrict the token to

token.description: Bearer token for the customer API. Shown once.

password.description: At least 8 characters. Required unless send_link is true

send_link.description: Email a link to choose a password instead

password.description: At least 8 characters. The login's API tokens are revoked.

options.description: Allowed values for select fields (value => label)

has_value.description: Secret fields only: whether a value is stored

settings.description: field key => value. Only the keys you send change; secrets are write-only.

fields.description: key is the dotted setting name, e.g. company.name

info.description: system: version, php, database, queue, cache, plugins_path, cron_url_configured, cli_cron

settings.description: Dotted setting key => value, e.g. {"company.name": "Acme", "billing.due_days": 14}. Only the keys you send change.

gateways.description: gateway key => {enabled, title, <gateway fields>}, e.g. {"stripe": {"enabled": true, "secret_key": "sk_live_..."}}

cron_url.description: Shown once; the previous URL stops working

secrets.description: Decrypted values stored by the provisioning module

client_id.description: Required on create; on a draft, changing it re-applies the new client's tax rate

items.description: Required on create; replaces all lines on update

issue.description: Create only: open the invoice straight away

send.description: Create only, with issue: email it

client_id.description: Required on create; on a draft, changing it re-applies the new client's tax rate

items.description: Required on create; replaces all lines on update

amount.description: Minor units, at most the balance due
Minor units. Omit to refund everything still refundable

create_invoice.description: Default true: place an order (pending service + invoice). false: create only the service, like "New service" in the admin UI

trial.description: create_invoice=true only: false bills now even when the product offers a trial

amount.description: create_invoice=false only: price in minor units (default: the product price)

invoice.description: null when create_invoice=false, or when a free trial started instead of an invoice

can_change_plan.description: False when the service cannot change plan (or, for customers, may not); options is then empty

timing.description: Default: upgrades now, downgrades at renewal. Staff only: customers cannot make a downgrade immediate

trial.description: On a trial nothing is prorated

credit.description: Unused part of the current period

charge.description: Rest of the period (or one full period when the cycle changes) at the new price

amount_due.description: charge minus credit, never below 0: the invoice total before tax

forfeited.description: Credit larger than the charge; it is not refunded or carried forward

invoice.description: Summary (id, uuid, number, status, total, balance, due_date, pay_url) of the proration invoice; null when nothing is due or the change is scheduled

PaymentMethod.description: Display details only: the provider token is never returned.

autopay.description: Invoices are charged to this method automatically

gateway_confirmed.description: false when the provider could not confirm the deletion (the method is removed here either way)

status.description: pending: processing, the payment appears when it clears. requires_action: pay with the provider checkout instead

payment_method_uuid.description: null once the method was removed

up_to.description: Cumulative upper bound; null is unbounded (last tier)

unit_price.description: Micro-minor units per unit in this tier

flat_fee.description: Micro-minor units, added once when the tier is reached

unit_price.description: Micro-minor units (1 = one millionth of a minor unit): per unit, or per package

aggregation.description: How records of a period combine

unit_price.description: Micro-minor units; required unless pricing_model is tiered

key.description: Lowercase letters, numbers, dashes, underscores; unique per product; cannot change later

prices.description: Replaces all prices of the meter

priced.description: false when the meter has no price for the currency

UsageSummary.description: Unbilled usage of the current period. Billed in arrears on the renewal invoice.

meters.description: Only meters that have unbilled usage

get.summary: API root: name and version
This OpenAPI document

post.summary: Exchange email and password (and, with two-factor authentication, an otp) for a bearer token

otp.description: Required when the account has two-factor authentication: the 6-digit authenticator code, or an unused recovery code. Always send it as a string. 5 wrong codes per 5 minutes (per user and IP) are allowed.

abilities.description: Limit the token, e.g. ["invoices.read"]. Must be valid for the account: customer abilities for customers, staff abilities for staff (see GET /admin/abilities). Omit for full access.

401.description: invalid_credentials; or, for accounts with two-factor authentication, otp_required (no otp sent) / invalid_otp (wrong, replayed or already used code)

403.description: two_factor_enrolment_required: staff must set up two-factor authentication first (Settings → Security requires it)
